title: fix(cloud-connection): the multi-replica install-local refusal names a recipe that works
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB8aotp4DmRT4nJzvmo4iY7K)_

Fixes #32176

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：企业版声明多副本后，install-local 的 409 拒绝提示改成真正走得通的步骤：先缩到 1 个副本，并以 `OS_CLUSTER_REPLICAS=1`、不设 `OS_EXPECT_MULTI_NODE` 重启它；再对它安装或卸载；最后恢复副本数和声明，重启每个副本。提示还写明这些步骤成立的前提：各副本要读同一个安装台账目录。拒绝本身不变，状态、代码、触发条件都和原来一样。
- 为什么改：旧提示让运维「跑安装脚本，再重启每个副本」。可安装脚本跑的是 `os package install`，它请求的正是这道被拒的门，照做一定再被拒。
- 风险与回滚：只改提示文字，另新增一个导出函数供 CLI 测试读同一段文字，运行行为不变。回滚方式是 revert。
- 先看：① `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` 里的 `multiReplicaInstallLocalRefusalMessage`（新文案）；② 同包 `marketplace-install-local-register-refusal.test.ts` 新增的「照提示做」两组测试；③ `packages/cli/test/package-install-refusal-rendering.test.ts` 新增的原样打印测试。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection exec vitest run src/marketplace-install-local-register-refusal.test.ts -t 'Redis driver'`，预期 12 条全绿，其中 4 条名字含 "the remedy the refusal names"，即照提示操作后能装上或卸掉。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`.** The install-local doors' multi-replica refusal message is spelled once, as the exported `multiReplicaInstallLocalRefusalMessage(subject)`. `refuseMultiReplicaPackageChange` answers it. The refusal's status (`409`), code (`MULTI_REPLICA_PACKAGE_CHANGE_REFUSED`) and trigger (`declaresMultiReplicaOnRedis`, read per request) are unchanged.
  - Old recipe: "Make the change in a maintenance window instead: run the install script, then restart every replica." That script runs `os package install`, which posts to this same door and is refused the same way.
  - New recipe: it says every client of the door, `os package install` and any script that runs it included, is refused the same way while the declaration stands. Then: scale the deployment to one replica and restart it with `OS_CLUSTER_REPLICAS=1` and `OS_EXPECT_MULTI_NODE` unset; run the install (or uninstall) against that replica; restore the replica count and the declaration and restart every replica.
  - The recipe names the setting precisely. The declaration is `declaresMultiNode` (`@objectstack/service-cluster`), which reads exactly `OS_EXPECT_MULTI_NODE` (`true`) and `OS_CLUSTER_REPLICAS` (greater than 1). `OS_CLUSTER_REPLICAS=1` with `OS_EXPECT_MULTI_NODE` unset reads false, so the door proceeds.
  - It also states the condition the restart step depends on. The other replicas pick the change up only from the install ledger they rehydrate at boot (`rehydrate`, the plugin's `kernel:ready` hook). That is `installed-packages` under `OS_HOME` (`resolveInstalledPackagesDir`) unless the host passes `storageDir`. So the change reaches every replica only when they all read that one directory. The host path itself is not printed: the GET listing serves `storageDir` only to a `manage_metadata` holder.
- **`packages/cloud-connection/src/index.ts`.** Exports `multiReplicaInstallLocalRefusalMessage`, so the CLI's pin reads the text from the one place it is spelled.
- **`packages/cli/src/commands/package/install.ts`: not changed.** It already prints any refusal as `Install failed (STATUS CODE): MESSAGE`, with the door's `error.message` verbatim and no case per code (`#21489`). It does not paraphrase this refusal. The new CLI pin holds that.
- **Docs: not changed.** No page under `content/docs/**` (outside the release-owned `releases/` and the generated `references/`) repeats the old recipe or describes the install-local refusal. Searched for `install script`, `restart every replica`, `install-packages`, `install-local` together with `replica`, and `MULTI_REPLICA`.
- **`.changeset/32176-multi-replica-install-local-remedy.md`.** A `patch` for `@objectstack/cloud-connection`, carrying both declaration lines.

## Why

The card's Expected: the refusal names steps that work under multi-replica, with a test pinning that the remedy text and the script path agree; the refusal itself does not change. Triage 6766682871 graded it p1 (HA, roadmap tier 1).

## Tests

All new pins sit in the files that already hold the surface's shared harness, as top-level cases.

**`marketplace-install-local-register-refusal.test.ts`, the multi-replica `describe` (cloud#3814 R6).** Each case below runs once per declaration form, `OS_CLUSTER_REPLICAS=3` and `OS_EXPECT_MULTI_NODE=true`.

- The existing refusal cases now assert the message equals `multiReplicaInstallLocalRefusalMessage(verb)` exactly. Before, they checked `toContain('run the install script, then restart every replica')`. The code, status, envelope and first-sentence assertions are unchanged.
- **New: "the remedy the refusal names installs the package, and every replica restarted over the ledger serves it".**
  1. The declared door refuses an inline install. That is the body `os package install FILE` posts.
  2. The test reads the settings the recipe names from the refusal's own text: every `NAME=value` and `NAME unset` after `instead:`. It fails if the recipe names none.
  3. It applies those settings to one replica (a boot over the same ledger). The same install answers `200` and is ledgered.
  4. It restores the declaration and boots two more replicas over the same ledger. Each serves the package, and each refuses the next change, so the declaration really stands again.
- **New: the same for an uninstall.** After the remedy, no restarted replica serves the package, and each refuses the next install.

**`packages/cli/test/package-install-refusal-rendering.test.ts`.** New: when the runtime refuses with `409 MULTI_REPLICA_PACKAGE_CHANGE_REFUSED` and the message from `multiReplicaInstallLocalRefusalMessage('Installing')`, `os package install` prints `Install failed (409 MULTI_REPLICA_PACKAGE_CHANGE_REFUSED): MESSAGE` with the whole message, and exits 1.

### Ablations

Each ablation ran from the committed fix at `85b323d0` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which wraps the run and restores the file. Every restore is proven: the blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty. No ablation needs a rebuild. The door's suite imports the plugin from source, and the CLI pin imports `install.ts` from source.

<details><summary>A — the old recipe back ("run the install script, then restart every replica"): the 4 remedy cases go red</summary>


So the pin holds that the recipe's settings really lift each declaration form. It does not just check that the recipe names some setting.
</details>

<details><summary>C — the CLI drops the recipe (prints the message up to "instead:"): the new CLI pin goes red, the three existing ones stay green</summary>

## Acceptance notes

- **File surface.** Beyond the claim's surface, this PR touches `packages/cloud-connection/src/index.ts` (one export) and `packages/cli/test/package-install-refusal-rendering.test.ts` (one new `describe`). The order asks to pin the text in one place and test that both surfaces read it, and the CLI cannot read the text without the export. `install.ts` is untouched.
- **The recipe's condition.** A replica with its own `OS_HOME` keeps its own ledger. No install through this door reaches it, before or after this change: that divergence is why the refusal exists (cloud#3814 R6). The new text says so instead of implying the restart heals it. This is noted, not filed. carrier: cloud (the multi-replica epic, cloud#3814).
- **The consumer's flag spelling.** The card cites cloud's `install-packages.sh` running `objectstack package install --runtime URL`. On `main`, `-r/--runtime` is retired with no alias (`install.ts` header, `#30126` row 13): the parser refuses it as an unknown flag, and the spelling is `-u URL`. That is the cloud script's business when it moves its pin. carrier: cloud.
- **A sibling text, out of this card's surface.** `packages/runtime/src/multi-replica-package-refusal.ts` (`multiReplicaPackageChangeMessage`, the runtime package doors) tells the operator to "run it on a single replica or through the CLI, then restart every replica". That has the same flaw: the doors key on the declaration, not on how many replicas run, so one replica is still refused until the declaration is lifted, and "through the CLI" names no command. It is reported to the seat to file, not fixed here.

## Verification

Local runs are against the merged head 0c9dc002 (`main` 43a51b55 merged into the fix commit 85b323d0), after the `@objectstack/cli^...` closure was rebuilt.

<details><summary>Tests and type checks on 0c9dc002: all green</summary>

The CLI suite was narrowed to the one touched file, `package-install-refusal-rendering.test.ts`. `install.ts` is unchanged, and the only cli edit is that test file. CI's `Test Core` runs the rest of the cli unit tier and its integration tier. Before the merge, on 85b323d0, the same cloud-connection run also read 80/80 files and 1194/1194 tests.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates on 0c9dc002: 70 derived, 70 run, all exit 0; dispatch-gates --ran reconciles 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 70 commands from the 5 changed paths, against merge base 43a51b55. Each ran serially, and each exit code was recorded.

- Two first answered 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET. Neither was a red:
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needs its pinned fixture commit, and this clone is shallow. I fetched `621a4876`, and it then passed 48 cases.
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` reads every published dist. I built the 11 packages that had none, and it then reported 122 require entry points across 72 packages loading, and 2588 CommonJS files parsing.
- Seven gates ran while that build held the box (`check:query-options-erasure` through `check:slot-lookup`). I ran those seven again after the build, and all exited 0.
- The full record is `CMD :: exit N` per line. `dispatch-gates --ran` read it: "70 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 70 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".

Families outside the derived total, which CI runs on this PR: the artifact rosters, the wide-population families, the path-scheduled jobs and the type-check lanes. Those are read from this PR's check-runs, not re-run here.
</details>
